openFindings.title: Relayout leaves a half-moved overlay folder when a rename or the manifest write fails after the first move
The commit gate silently skips every overlay check when the overlay folder is not found
The LAYOUT overflow line advises apply --relayout even when the entries it counts are ones relayout refuses
The strict-write refusal tells an operator to create a copy for a path the overlay removes, and apply never installs it
No test covers the pre-commit git hook overlay lookup or its skip branch
The phase 002 spec's adoptSource evidence pointers no longer resolve, and its caller count is stale
The doctor overlay presentation asset documents only one of the two LAYOUT remedies the engine emits

nodes.question: Do the Barter hooks (barter-overlay-guard-core.cjs, barter-git-write-gate.mjs, the OpenCode plugins and the pre-commit git hook) learn both overlay locations correctly, and do they fail open or fail closed in the right cases when the overlay folder is missing, moved or ambiguous? Check every vendored and overlay copy agrees. The repo is nested: read it with git -C barter/ai-speckit show a954fc956ce.

results.summary: Criteria 2, 3 and 5 hold on the tree as it stands; criterion 5 was executed this iteration rather than inferred.

Criterion 5 was executed: --guard exits 1 and names ../overlays/framework/skills/sk-git/sk-git-skilled/SKILL.md. Criterion 4 was executed: status --json reports PASSED with an empty offLayout. The remedy wording on that line is still wrong and is carried as the open P2 R11-P2-001, not as a gap in this protocol's evidence.
The release entry carries the frontmatter the changelog convention requires.
